LanguageData.Tolgrim_MechControlRangeTip: Maximum radius (in cells) around the mechanitor where drafted mechs can be actively commanded in combat (24.9 cells).
LanguageData.Tolgrim_MechsControlledTip: Number of mechs currently actively controlled online vs total overseen mechs linked to this mechanitor.
LanguageData.Tolgrim_ControlGroupsTip: Control groups currently assigned vs total available limit for this mechanitor.
LanguageData.Tolgrim_NoMechEquipment: No equipment with mechanitor bonuses equipped.
LanguageData.Tolgrim_SettingsMoveRecipes: Move mechanitor implant crafting to Subcore Encoder
LanguageData.Tolgrim_SettingsMoveRecipesTip: Moves all mechanitor implant recipes (sublinks, remote repairers, etc., including from compatible mods) from the Machining Table to the Subcore Encoder. This declutters the Machining Table and groups all mechanitor-related tech into its dedicated workstation.
LanguageData.Tolgrim_SettingsShowCommandRangeTip: Toggles visibility of the mech command radius row under General Information.
LanguageData.Tolgrim_SettingsShowControlGroupsTip: Toggles visibility of the control groups row under General Information.
LanguageData.Tolgrim_SettingsShowImplantsTip: Enables the list of detected mechanitor implants on the pawn.
LanguageData.Tolgrim_SettingsShowEquipmentTip: Enables the list of apparel and weapons providing mechanitor bonuses.
LanguageData.Tolgrim_NeurofibreBonusTip: Permanent bandwidth bonus granted by the installed Mech Neurofibre implant.
LanguageData.Tolgrim_BandnodeSeraDesc: Permanent bandwidth gained from administered Bandnode Sera doses (+1 per dose).
LanguageData.Tolgrim_BandnodeSeraDisabled: Bandnode Sera are currently disabled in Mod Settings.
LanguageData.Tolgrim_BandnodeSeraMaxReached: Maximum Bandnode Sera limit reached ({0} doses).
LanguageData.Tolgrim_BandnodeSerumUsedMsg: {0} permanently gained +1 mech bandwidth from Bandnode Serum ({1}/{2} doses).
LanguageData.Tolgrim_SettingsEnableNeurofibreTip: When disabled, Neurofibre implants stop granting bandwidth bonuses and cannot be surgically installed, without deleting existing implants from saves.
LanguageData.Tolgrim_SettingsEnableBandnodeSeraTip: When disabled, Bandnode Sera stop granting bandwidth bonuses and cannot be administered, without deleting saved dose counts.
LanguageData.Tolgrim_SettingsMaxBandnodeDoses: Max Bandnode Sera doses per mechanitor
LanguageData.Tolgrim_SettingsEnableEnemyMechsTip: Allows player gestators and mechanitors to resurrect and reprogram enemy mechanoid corpses using subcores and components, converting them permanently into colony mechs.
LanguageData.Tolgrim_SettingsEnableApocritonGestation: Enables the recipe to gestate an Apocriton directly at the Large Mech Gestator (requires Ultra Mechtech).
LanguageData.Tolgrim_SettingsSuppressHateAuraTip: Prevents colony-aligned or friendly Apocritons from causing Hate Aura mood debuffs to colonists.
LanguageData.Tolgrim_SettingsEnableApocritonRechargeT: Allows colony Apocritons to gradually regenerate their mech resurrection ability charges over time.
LanguageData.Tolgrim_SettingsInstantGestationTip: Sets mechanoid forming speed to maximum so gestation cycles complete almost instantaneously.
LanguageData.Tolgrim_SettingsInfiniteEnergyTip: Keeps colony mechanoid energy permanently full without draining over time.
LanguageData.Tolgrim_SettingsDisableWastepacksTip: Prevents colony mechanoids from generating toxic wastepacks when recharging.
LanguageData.Tolgrim_RenameControlGroupTip: Change the label of this mechanoid control group.
LanguageData.Tolgrim_SettingsEncoderRecipesDesc: Enable or disable recipes and customize the material costs required to craft each item at the Subcore Encoder.
LanguageData.Tolgrim_SetMechColorDesc: Set an individual accent color for this mechanoid.
LanguageData.Tolgrim_SetDefaultMechColorDesc: Set a default accent color for all mechs controlled by this mechanitor.
